An AddOn that graphically displays relative threat (aggro) generated toward a particular target. Sometimes known as "KLH", "KTM", or just "Threat Meter". If multiple people have this AddOn in the raid, you can all see each other's threat on the overall of the fight (or on a set master target). People who don't have KTM will not appear on the meter. This is considered useful on many guilds to make sure you are under the Main Tank's aggro. KLH Threat Meter is an aggregate threat monitor, so will not report threat for multi-mob encounters, unlike the Omen AddOn. Also, Omen can gather threat information from characters using KTM. After Patch 2.4, Omen is no longer compatible with KTM.

Kael's Vial Remnant is a quest item required for attunement to the Battle for Mount Hyjal wing in the Caverns of Time. It is said that Illidan Stormrage took seven vials of water from the Well of Eternity before its destruction. Three were poured into the lake at the top of Mount Hyjal, but the other four were believed to have been lost. It was revealed that Illidan gave one each to his two top lieutenants, Kael'thas Sunstrider and Lady Vashj. This item is required for The Vials of Eternity.

Kalandrios is an air elemental located at the Throne of the Elements in Nagrand. Shortly before the Cataclysm, Thrall journeyed to Garadar to discover why the elements of Azeroth were so afraid. During this event, Thrall would communicate with Kalandrios to see if the fury could enlighten him to what was causing the elements their fear. In response, Kalandrios questioned why he should care for trails of air in another land when his own essence suffered in Outland. If you attacked somebody around him, he would one shot you. He's currently not involved in any quests.

Kaja'mite is a type of ore found primarily beneath Mount Kajaro on Kezan. It can also be found on the Lost Isles and Zandalar. The consumption of vaporized kaja'mite causes a range of effects, such as heightened senses, hallucinations and increased intelligence. Stopping consumption of kaja'mite leads to a marked decline in intelligence however. It's most famously responsible for having given the goblins their high intelligence and helping them evolve into masters of alchemy and engineering. They consider it to be the most valuable ore in existence, and by goblin law, all kaja'mite belongs to goblins. The mineral is used in the creation of an intelligence-boosting drink, :Kaja'Cola, and in t

The Kalu'ak Fishing Derby was a fishing event held every Saturday between 14:00 and 15:00 server time by the Kalu'ak. The objective was to be the first player to catch a Blacktip Shark and bring it to Elder Clearwater in Dalaran. It was introduced with Patch 3.3.0. Due to problems that occurred with the introduction of cross-realm zones, all fishing tournaments were disabled. When they were reenabled in Patch 5.1.0 however, the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza had been redesigned to allow three winners, and included the rewards from winning the fishing derby. Thus, the Kalu'ak Fishing Derby became redundant, and was removed altogether.

Kagrosh can be found dead in a hall of the Deathforge. He was a member of Scout Zagran's scouting group sent by Blood Guard Gulmok to observe the Forge. Wanting to become a hero, he descended into the Deathforge and was killed there, most likely due to his weakness in the subtlety department. Before he died he managed to steal the Deathforge Key.

The Kajaro Trading Company or KTC is a small company within the Bilgewater Cartel that does a variety of things from mining Kaja'mite to processing oil and even producing Kaja'Cola.

Kaja'mine is a mine containing the last known supply of Kaja'mite (before more was found on the Lost Isles), however, the mine is starting to run out. The Kajaro Trading Company owns it and uses forest trolls as slaves to gather the ore for them. The KTC then makes the ore into Kaja'Cola. Troll Slaves, Defiant Trolls, and Tunneling Worms can be found throughout the mine.

Kala'ma is a jungle troll hunter located in the Northern Barrens who has been put in charge of collecting and training new raptor mounts for the Horde. After he had an unfortunate run-in with , he asks Horde adventurers to do this task for him. He also has a rather severe speech impediment as a result from the attack: he can't pronounce the letters 'r' and 'l' any more, but says 'w' instead. He's also a bit forgetful. After he shrunk raptors using voodoo, he can't remember how to undo the spell.
Kai'ju Gahz'rilla is a level 80 Elemental Unrest version of the boss from Zul'Farrak.

Kag is the First Mate of the Horde trading ship Orgath'ar. While on a trip to deliver supplies to Razor Hill, the ship was attacked by human pirates under cover of heavy fog. While the crew of the Orgath'ar was able to repel the attack, some of the cargo was damaged.
Kall Worthaton is the trike vendor for the Bilgewater Cartel, located in the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar. Only goblins and Horde players exalted with the Bilgewater can buy from him.

The Kaldorei Wind Chimes are a rare archaeology artifact that requires 225 skill to find and 98 Night Elf Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to three Highborne Scroll keystones may be used to complete it.
__NOTOC__ Kaldorei Amphora is a common archaeology artifact. It requires 35 Night Elf Archaeology Fragments to solve. One Highborne Scroll keystone may be used to aid in solving it.

Kaja'mite Cavern is a cavern filled with, as it's name suggests, kaja'mite. The cave is found southeast of Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles. The cavern walls are filled with paintings, which appear to have been done by the pygmies which use the cave for rituals of worship. Foreman Dampwick is outside the entrance trying to enlist help to protect his miners from harm by the Smart Mining Monkeys inside. It is discovered that a pygmy witchdoctor was controlling the monkeys inside the mine.

__NOTOC__ Kaldrigos, referred to as "the dread wyrm", and "the great wyrm" was a dragon slain years ago by a group of at least four dwarves. At least three of the dwarves were killed, but it is known that they ultimately triumphed over the blue wyrm.

Kaivax (real name Randy Jordan) is a Blizzard employee and Community Manager for the World of Warcraft forums. Jordan started at Blizzard as a CM for the World of Warcraft community and was introduced on February 28th, 2011. He was a former co-host of The Instance podcast, which he could no longer participate in as a Blizzard employee. Jordan changed teams from WoW to StarCraft/Heroes of the Storm in September 2012. On June 27, 2014, it was announced that he was returning to the World of Warcraft team.

Kafa Press acts as a potion which provides a 4000 haste bonus for 25 seconds. It is not consumed when used. It does share a cooldown with other potions, so it will not provide an advantage to raiders who use potions. While its cooldown is 10 minutes, the CD that it triggers in potions is their standard length (one minute). If you also happen to be drunk, this item will also dispell a very small amount of it.

Kalidar was a planned battleground for the original World of Warcraft that never made it to live. It had a Warcraft III multiplayer and/or MOBA-style design, with three separate lanes in a forested area with a coloration similar to the Felwood seen in A Destiny of Flame and Sorrow.
